key: lib:part -> pin number -> {name, etype, unit, unit_name}
notes: Covers every part that needs a simulation model (logic, memory, clock, switch); passives/connectors/power symbols are excluded and listed in report.md.
unit/unit_name come from the component 'units' blocks in the netlist (authoritative for how the part is instantiated).
lib_unit is the unit number inside the KiCad symbol; 0 means the pin belongs to the common body shared by all units.
~{NAME} is KiCad's overbar notation for an active-low pin.
pins always include the power pins.
